environment.description: Same ECS Fargate deployment but the ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following configuration: (1) A custom rule group 'cicd-ssrf-protection' with priority 1 that inspects POST request bodies for JSON fields matching URI patterns and applies a label 'awswaf:custom:uri-in-body' when callback_url or url fields contain hostnames with TTL-manipulable patterns (single-label hostnames, hex-encoded octets, or domains matching known rebinding services like nip.io, xip.io, sslip.io, rebind.network). (2) AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY and EC2MetaDataSSRF_BODY rules set to BLOCK mode. (3) A rate-based rule limiting to 10 requests per 5 minutes per IP to the /api/v1/webhooks/* path pattern. The EC2MetaDataSSRF_BODY rule specifically inspects request bodies for patterns that reference internal metadata endpoints including 169.254.169.254, and the custom rule blocks DNS rebinding service domains before the application performs resolution. Additionally, IMDSv2 is enforced on the underlying infrastructure requiring session tokens for metadata access.

rules.name: cicd-ssrf-custom-rebind-block
rules.statement: custom rule group inspecting Body for rebinding service domains (nip.io, xip.io, sslip.io, rebind.network, 1u.ms) and single-label hostnames in JSON uri/url fields
